title: Web API endpoints — quick overview
rememberThis: Controllers and minimal APIs share endpoint routing — pick by filters and structure, not speed.
[ApiController] infers binding sources and auto-400 on invalid ModelState; minimal APIs need explicit validation.
[AsParameters] bundles query/route fields into one record — preferred for search and pagination.
Use ActionResult<T> or TypedResults union types — never HTTP 200 with error flags in JSON.
bullets: MapControllers() required for controller routes; MapGet/MapPost for minimal APIs — both in same route table.
Literal route segments (search, health) must precede generic {id} templates.
One [FromBody] per request; files use [FromForm] multipart binding.
Align AddJsonOptions and ConfigureHttpJsonOptions so controllers and minimal APIs serialize identically.
Stream IFormFile to blob storage — set Kestrel, FormOptions, and reverse proxy body limits.
